name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ExistenceTwo(has_key) captures the two-different-moves requirement, and the hard Existence(at_goal) with the Precedence chain (has_key→door_open, door_open→at_goal) forces the key and door while recording the stated order.

texts: At least two different moments, the agent is holding the key.
The door is open only after the agent has acquired the key.
The goal is reached only after the door has been opened.
